title: DFU HBOT Bounded Regimen and Execution Burden
description: This knowledge object estimates the execution burden of a contemplated outpatient HBOT course. It combines a fixed population-level regimen range with one selected facility, patient-reported travel distance and duration, and reported weekday-attendance difficulty.
